domain: all n : Nat, all R : Type with CommRing R, all vectors b,u : Fin n -> R, all J : Finset (Fin n), all f : Finset (Fin n) -> R

definition_semantics.prefixMatrix: -(1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) + replicateCol Unit u * replicateRow Unit (fun _ => 1)
definition_semantics.principalMinor: (prefixMatrix u).submatrix Subtype.val Subtype.val, actual index type J
definition_semantics.insertionCoefficient: if j notin J and K = insert j J then 1 else 0
definition_semantics.singleResponse: -sum K : Finset (Fin n), phase K * insertionCoefficient j J K
definition_semantics.weightedResponse: sum j, b j * singleResponse j J
definition_semantics.familyResponse: sum J : Finset (Fin n), f J * weightedResponse b J

leaves.name: sum_complement
leaves.statement: (sum j in J.compl, b j) = total b - sum j in J, b j

leaves.name: single_response
leaves.statement: singleResponse j J = if j notin J then phase J else 0

leaves.name: weighted_response
leaves.statement: weightedResponse b J = phase J * (total b - sum j in J, b j)

leaves.name: minor_determinant
leaves.statement: (principalMinor u J).det = phase J * (1 - sum j in J, u j)

leaves.name: normalized_minor_response
leaves.hypothesis: forall j, total b * u j = b j
leaves.statement: total b * (principalMinor u J).det = weightedResponse b J

leaves.name: linear_extension
leaves.hypothesis: forall j, total b * u j = b j
leaves.statement: total b * (sum J : Finset (Fin n), f J * (principalMinor u J).det) = familyResponse b f
